name: TC-BF-001 — 买手编辑Brief表单字段展示 [P0]
description: 验证Brief草稿态表单展示6大分组字段：基础与风格、目标人群、货盘与上新计划、视觉参考、试拍准备

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const groups = ['基础与风格', '目标人群', '货盘与上新计划', '视觉参考', '试拍准备']; const fields = ['迭代名称', '风格定位', '年龄', '职业', '品类占比', '上新节奏', '单次上新量', '对标店铺', '参考视觉图', '首次试拍商品']; const foundGroups = groups.filter(g => text.includes(g)); const foundFields = fields.filter(f => text.includes(f)); return { foundGroups, foundFields, allGroupsFound: foundGroups.length === groups.length }; })()

(() => { const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab, [class*=tab]')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasBrief = tabs.some(t => t.includes('Brief')); const activeTab = document.querySelector('.ant-tabs-tab-active, [class*=tab-active]')?.textContent.trim(); return { tabs, hasBrief, activeTab }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在DRAFT_BRIEF状态的迭代，当前用户是店铺买手
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 进入迭代详情页
2. 验证默认进入Brief tab
3. 检查表单展示6大分组
4. 检查各字段控件正确展示
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 默认进入Brief tab
2. 表单展示：迭代名称(输入框)、风格定位(多行文本)、年龄(多选)、职业(多选)、品类占比(组件)、上新节奏(单选)、单次上新量(数字)、对标店铺(组件)、参考视觉图(图片选择)、首次试拍商品(item id输入)
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/Brief协作
